The knowledge base articles I found address data export requests but don't cover data deletion or account removal. I need to be honest about this limitation and direct the customer appropriately.

---

Thank you for your GDPR data deletion request. I understand you want to permanently delete all your personal data.

The knowledge base articles available to me address how to export your data (via Account Settings > Privacy > Request Data Export), but they don't contain instructions for permanent data deletion or account removal. Since this is a legal matter requiring compliance with GDPR requirements, I need to escalate your request to ensure it's handled correctly and documented properly.

Please reply to confirm this is a formal deletion request, and our team will process it according to GDPR requirements. We'll contact you with next steps and any information we need from you to verify your identity and complete the deletion.
